method: Six regional research agents (WebSearch + WebFetch) resolved the 179 Florida rows whose booking method was unknown. EVIDENCE RULE: a platform+URL is recorded only where the booking link was published on the course's own site (or its operator's). Where an agent inferred a TeeItUp alias merely because <name>.book.teeitup.com resolved, the platform is DROPPED and the row is recorded as online-without-a-verified-link: a live subdomain is not proof of an alias (build_registry.py, Golden Hills note) and a wrong alias publishes another club's sheet.
